caption: The video showcases a calm, mirror-like water surface reflecting a bright blue sky filled with white cumulus clouds, with a faint yellowish-green blur visible underwater at the bottom. A thin high wispy cloud streak drifts slowly leftward across the top, while the main cumulus clouds and their reflections stay in place, so the drift reflects cloud motion rather than camera movement. About a third of the way through, a small dark speck appears on the right side of the water and persists to the end. The underwater blur stays largely in place with only minor fluctuation. Faint ripple lines show within the left-side reflection, but the broad surface remains glassy. The scene is near-static apart from these subtle changes.
